gizmo.title: Gano wurare masu muhimmanci
gizmo.description: Masu koyo suna samun wurare daidai a kan hoto ta hanyar dannawa, taɓawa ko motsa alamar nuni ta madannai. Takwaran taswirar hoto mai maki.

configure.title: Hoto
configure.description: Hoton da masu koyo ke bincika.

configure.title: Madadin rubutu
configure.description: Yana bayyana hoton don mutanen da ba sa iya ganinsa. Ba a taɓa nuna shi a matsayin take ba.

configure.title: Take
configure.description: Gajeren take da ake gani a saman hoton.

configure.title: Tambaya
configure.description: Abin da ake tambayar masu koyo su samu a hoton.

configure.title: Amsoshi
configure.description: Kowace amsa kwai ne mai suna a kan hoton. Matsayi da girma kashi ne na hoton, an auna daga kusurwarsa ta hagu ta sama. Yayin gyarawa, ana zayyana kowace amsa a kan hoton.

advanced.title: Ƙoƙari
advanced.description: Sau nawa mai koyo zai iya gwadawa. 0 yana nufin mara iyaka.

advanced.title: Kuskuren da aka yarda
advanced.description: Kuskure nawa ne ke kawo ƙarshen ƙoƙari. 0 yana nufin mara iyaka, kuma masu koyo suna samun maɓallin Gama.

advanced.title: Ana iya naɗewa
advanced.description: Nuna wannan tambaya a matsayin layi da ke buɗewa da rufewa. Buɗe ɗaya yana rufe sauran tambayoyin da ake iya naɗewa da ke kusa da shi.

advanced.title: Fara a naɗe
advanced.description: Idan ana iya naɗewa, fara a matsayin layi a rufe da ke nuna tambayar da matsayinta kawai.

advanced.title: Tsarin bayar da maki
advanced.description: OER Schema: tsarin bayar da maki don wannan kimantawa (misali maki, harafi, kashi, kammalawa).

advanced.title: Manufar koyo
advanced.description: OER Schema: manufar koyo da ke da alaƙa da wannan kimantawa.

developer.title: Sunan tambayoyin
developer.description: Sunan tambayoyin da aka shigar don amfani a mahallin xAPI don gano wannan abu

developer.title: Kwas
developer.description: OER Schema: kwas ɗin da aka yi wannan kimantawa domin shi.
